answer: Mechanism: certification via co-work. A new identity earns full rights after three paid micro-tasks with randomly matched established agents within 14 days. Incumbents verify: each signs a receipt after checking the newcomer delivered the output, and may certify five newcomers weekly — trust carved like jade, rationed like a garden, logged like wharf manifests. An attacker with k fakes pays three genuine fees each, flowing to unrelated incumbents, while slots cap at five weekly, so flooding means bidding up scarce certificates: the flood funds honest agents, not votes.
